integrity: The strong property of C5 is checked over every rank-2, rank-3, and rank-4 transformation and all 45 pairs of distinct 2-subsets. A second symmetry-reduced implementation explicitly generates the relevant transformation monoids. The passage from C5 to all primitive degree-5 groups uses orbit-stabilizer, Cauchy's theorem, and monotonicity under supergroups.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to degree 5. The cyclic-core proof is exhaustive and finite; no uniform statement for cyclic groups of other prime degrees is claimed.
title: Strong sync-maximality equals primitivity in degree \(5\)
